reference_anchors: <Picture 1> (image_1): atmosphere and visual style — colossal circular concentric-ring metal gate around a field of absolute black, cold desaturated green-grey high-contrast light, wet reflective floor, sparse dim metal frames, crates and hazy depth at the sides.
<Picture 2> (image_2): protagonist identity — face, dark mid-length hair, slender build, long black over-knee tailored coat, black top and trousers, black lace-up platform boots.
open_design: [Shot 2]: what the gate's answer looks like — thin cold light waking along the innermost ring and sweeping around it, cold reflections rising across the wet floor, the listener's readable back view lifting its head, the gate's centre staying black.
[Shot 3]: the listener's profile reaction in close-up, the first and only moment where the face carried by <Picture 2> is exposed.
The 15-second split (7.2 / 5.2 / 2.6 s), the framing of the two added shots, and all audio design after the locked [Shot 1] audio.

content_events.text: A colossal circular cosmic gate built of concentric metal rings nearly fills the frame, with a centre of absolute darkness.
The ground beneath the gate is wet and reflective, holding dim cold light and reflections of the gate.
The protagonist stands before the gate as a very small back-view figure in the lower part of the frame, offset to the right.

editing_treatments.text: [Shot 1] is an ultra-wide establishing shot with a slow forward push-in (dolly in) that keeps the gate as the dominant centred mass while the protagonist remains very small and off-centre right in the lower frame.
The on-screen main title fades in from the edge of the darkness, blurred and barely legible at first and resolving to full sharpness.
[Shot 1] ends on a hard cut with no fade or dissolve, and that boundary cuts into a new event state rather than ending the video.

On-screen packaging: the main title in [Shot 1] reads "THE STARS WERE LISTENING" in a very narrow, heavy, all-caps typeface in dark red mixed with rust red, with slight grain and fogged, blurred edges.

A distant metallic vibration is present under [Shot 1].
One soft hit is synchronized exactly with the moment the title becomes fully sharp.

developments.visible_change: The frame settles from near-black immensity into a legible relationship: a lone back-view figure standing small at the base of the sealed gate on wet reflective ground, while the gate's centre holds absolute darkness and nothing answers.
developments.outcome: The standoff is established — the gate is sealed and silent and the listener is waiting alone; the hard cut leaves the answer ungiven.

developments.visible_change: A thin line of cold light wakes along the gate's innermost ring and sweeps around it, the wet floor lifts that light into cold reflections, the listener's head rises toward the light while the gate's centre stays absolute black, and the listener's profile opens into the rising light.
developments.outcome: The sealed gate is no longer silent: the listener is answered, and the video's final image is the listener's lit profile facing the unanswered darkness at the gate's centre.

shots.content_purpose: Establish the sealed circular gate and the lone listener at the gate's own immense scale on wet reflective ground, and land the main title over the darkness before a hard cut.
shots.start_state: Untouched dark: the gate's concentric rings occupy almost the whole frame with absolute black at the centre; the wet floor holds dim cold reflections; the protagonist is a very small back-view figure in the lower frame, offset right, facing the gate; no title is visible yet; the deep low-frequency pulse and distant metallic vibration are already running.
shots.action: The camera pushes in slowly with small amplitude toward the black centre of the gate while the figure stays small and off-centre right; the protagonist holds still with their back to the camera; the ground's reflections stretch toward the bottom edge; the main title fades in from the edge of the darkness, blurred and barely legible, then resolves to full sharpness; one soft hit lands as the title turns sharp; the shot ends on a hard cut.
shots.end_state: The gate is exactly as sealed as before with its centre still absolutely black; the listener still stands small in the lower right, back to camera; the title is fully sharp over the darkness; nothing has answered.
sound_cues: One soft hit lands on the exact frame where the title reaches full sharpness; no other sound is accented at that frame.

shots.content_purpose: Show the gate answering the listener: cold light wakes in the innermost ring and spreads around it, mirrored in the wet floor, while the listener's now-readable back view lifts its head and the gate's centre stays black.
shots.start_state: Same location and moment at a closer scale directly after the hard cut: the protagonist is seen from behind, with the long black over-knee coat, black trousers, black lace-up platform boots and dark mid-length hair now readable against the wet floor; the gate's rings are still dark and its centre is still absolute black; the wet floor reflects only dim cold light.
shots.action: A thin line of cold light wakes along the gate's innermost ring and sweeps around it, and the wet floor lifts that light into cold reflections; the protagonist holds still and then slowly lifts their head toward the light while still turned away from the camera; the gate's centre stays absolute black; the camera continues a slow forward creep at a smaller amplitude and settles into a near-static hold as the lit line closes the ring.
shots.end_state: The innermost ring is fully lit and cold light climbs the structure and the listener's silhouette while the gate's centre remains absolute darkness; the listener stands facing it with head lifted.
sound_cues: As the light line closes the ring, the deep pulse swells and a thin metallic ring resonance peaks with it.
shots.cut_reason: This boundary is the user-locked hard cut at the end of [Shot 1]; the answering light is a new event state that the locked ultra-wide framing and slow push-in cannot carry.
shots.continuity_bridge: Same location and moment: the gate stays the dominant centred circular mass, the protagonist keeps the same silhouette, coat, boots and back-to-camera orientation, the wet floor continues to reflect, and the centre of the gate stays absolute black across the transition.

shots.content_purpose: Land the answer on the listener: a close profile of the protagonist as the cold light rises, exposing for the first and only time the face carried by <Picture 2>.
shots.start_state: The ring light is already bright ahead of the listener; the protagonist's profile is still unlit and unreadable in the dark, the head only partly lifted, still facing the gate; the sustained low tone is running.
shots.action: A tight three-quarter close-up from behind and beside the listener's shoulder: dark mid-length hair falls past the jaw, the cold ring light falls on the profile from ahead and draws a hard rim along the brow, cheek, lips and jaw while the gate's black centre sits behind; the eyes open into the light with the ring's cold line glinting in the eye, and the head lifts a little further toward the gate; the final frame holds on the lit profile with no release.
shots.end_state: The listener's profile is visible in cold rim light with the ring's line glinting in the eye, still facing the gate; the answer is still rising and nothing is resolved.
sound_cues: A single soft breath is audible as the eyes open; the sustained low tone continues underneath and is still sounding at the final frame.
shots.cut_reason: The facial response, and the identity anchor carried by <Picture 2>, cannot be observed at the ultra-wide and wide scales of the previous shots without breaking their locked staging.
shots.continuity_bridge: Same continuous moment: the cold ring light ahead of the listener keeps brightening, the palette, haze and grain match the previous shot, and the head continues the same upward lift that began in [Shot 2].

constraints: Deep low-frequency pulse under [Shot 1] and continuing as the base layer (user-locked).
One soft hit synchronized exactly with the moment the title becomes fully sharp (user-locked).
No dialogue, lyrics or voice-over anywhere in the video.
No audio asset was supplied, so no existing audio signal may be copied or referenced.
audio_plan.auditory_focus: The deep low-frequency pulse and its single swell into the gate's sustained answering tone; it remains the lead layer from the first frame to the last.
audio_plan.continuous_bed: Cold, vast wet-space ambience: the low-frequency pulse bed with a faint distant metallic vibration, thin air and faint dripping echoes off the reflective floor, running under all three shots.

key_sound_events.trigger: The main title resolves from blurred to fully sharp over the darkness.
key_sound_events.sound: One soft hit — a single low-mid impact with a short decay.
key_sound_events.sync: The hit lands on the same frame the title reaches full sharpness; nothing else is accented at that frame.

key_sound_events.trigger: The thin light line wakes on the innermost ring and sweeps around it until it closes the ring.
key_sound_events.sound: The deep pulse swells into a sustained low tone with a thin metallic ring resonance on top.
key_sound_events.sync: The swell begins on the first lit frame and the resonance peaks as the lit line closes the ring.

key_sound_events.trigger: The listener's eyes open into the rising light.
key_sound_events.sync: The breath coincides with the eyes opening; the sustained low tone continues underneath and is still sounding at the last frame.

music_decision.function: The user-locked low-frequency pulse bed and metallic resonance already carry continuity, tension and pacing, so no audience-only score is added.
music_decision.tempo_energy_basis: The tight, compact pacing is carried by the pulse's slow swell and the hard cuts rather than by musical tempo.
music_decision.dynamic_arc: No score; the sound-design pulse rises once through [Shot 2] and stays unresolved at the end.

audio_plan.mix_priority: The low-frequency pulse and its answering swell lead; the title hit and the ring resonance are single clear accents; the wet-space ambience and dripping echoes sit underneath; no dialogue or music competes.
audio_plan.ending_state: The sustained low tone is still sounding as the final frame holds on the listener's lit profile — continuing and unresolved, with no final impact.

uncertainties: Shot 1 staging conflict: the user places the protagonist in the lower part of the frame offset to the right, while <Picture 1> shows the figure at frame centre; the user's instruction takes precedence and <Picture 1> is used for atmosphere and visual style only.

<Picture 1>'s back-view figure and <Picture 2>'s character-sheet model are merged into a single protagonist on the basis of matching build, hair length and black outfit; their real identity match is unconfirmed.

[Shot 2] and [Shot 3] are designed completion for the user's stated incomplete prompt and for the hard cut that requires content to cut into. If the intended video ends at the hard cut, both shots and their audio should be removed.
It is ambiguous whether the deep low-frequency pulse is intended as an audience-only score or as in-world ambience; it is planned as the continuous soundscape, with non-diegetic music set to N/A.
Side signage in <Picture 1> is unreadable and unused, and the poster's smaller line "SOMETHING ANSWERED BELOW" is excluded because <Picture 1> was locked to atmosphere and visual style.
No audio asset was supplied, so no existing audio signal is copied or referenced, and the entire sound design is newly generated.

experiment.user_request: 写实电影感，高反差光影，节奏紧凑。图1作为整体氛围、风格参考。图2作为主角人物参考。 Shot 1 — 超广角建立镜头。巨大圆形宇宙门几乎占满画面，人物只是门前一个很小的背影，站在画面下方偏右。地面潮湿反光，门中心一片黑暗。镜头慢慢向前推进。大标题从黑暗边缘渐入，先模糊后清晰："THE STARS WERE LISTENING" 字体极窄、厚重、全大写，暗红混合铁锈红，带轻微颗粒和雾化边缘。 Audio: 深低频脉冲，远处金属轻震，文字清晰时一记轻 hit。 → Hard cut. （非完整Prompt，可自行补充细节）
